nodes.name: Roya AI Dynamo
nodes.description: AI-powered SaaS platform that turns uploaded CSV data into auto-generated dashboards.

nodes.name: Admin Portal
nodes.description: Platform administration — manage users, subscriptions, audit logs, and system settings.

nodes.name: Customer Portal
nodes.description: The end-user product — create projects, upload data, generate and view dashboards.

nodes.name: Mobile App
nodes.description: Modeled abstractly; concrete stack chosen when mobile is built.

nodes.name: AI Processing
nodes.description: Orchestrates AI background jobs — CSV column analysis and dashboard generation.

nodes.name: Audit Logs
nodes.description: Immutable system-wide audit trail; admin read access.

nodes.name: Auth
nodes.description: Registration, login, OAuth, JWT lifecycle, password reset, current-user.

nodes.name: Dashboards
nodes.description: Dashboard lifecycle, widgets, dynamic data-serving endpoints, caching.

spec.audience: editors, viewers, public via share link

nodes.name: Data
nodes.description: CSV file lifecycle — upload, row persistence, column metadata, reuse.

nodes.name: Export
nodes.description: PDF and Excel/CSV exports of dashboard data.

spec.audience: editors and viewers with export permission

nodes.name: Notifications
nodes.description: In-app and email notifications for generation, errors, and share events.

nodes.name: System Settings
nodes.description: Global system configuration, feature flags, AI model settings.

nodes.name: Sharing
nodes.description: Secure shareable dashboard links with view/edit permissions.

nodes.name: Subscriptions
nodes.description: Plans, user subscriptions, usage-limit enforcement, payment webhooks.

nodes.name: Users
nodes.description: User profiles, roles, admin user management, GDPR deletion.

subfeatures: build prompt from column metadata (never raw rows)
write back AI descriptions and inferred types
create dashboard with purpose + data sources
fetch chart data per widget (cache -> DB -> recalc)
confirm columns to unlock dashboard generation
backend streams file to R2 (no direct frontend upload)
AI model configuration (no raw key exposure)

spec.contract: analyzeColumns(metadata), generateDashboard(spec) — receives only column metadata, never raw rows.
send(template, to, vars) — transactional email only.
getAuthUrl, exchangeCode — backend handles the callback.
createSubscription, manageSubscription, verifyWebhook — webhook signatures validated.
upload(buffer), getSignedUrl(key), delete(key) — backend only, never called from frontend.

nodes.name: Upload Screen (Mobile)
nodes.description: Planned mobile projection of CSV upload; not yet specced or built.

states.loading: progress bar during upload + analysis polling
states.success: advance to column review then done

spec.trigger: enqueued by data.uploadFile after R2 upload
